product.name: ZKProofPort
product.tagline: Privacy Infrastructure for the Next Generation of dApps
product.description: ZKProofPort is a complete zero-knowledge proof pipeline from Noir circuits to mobile proof generation to on-chain verification.

use_cases: DAO governance with one-person-one-vote via nullifiers
ZKPSwap: compliant DEX with privacy-preserving KYC

steps: Create a dApp and get your API key

security.nullifier: keccak256(keccak256(address + signalHash) + scope) — prevents proof reuse
security.privacy: Zero knowledge: verifier learns nothing beyond the proved statement
security.on_chain: Trustless verification via Solidity smart contracts

partners.powered_by: Aztec Network — Creator of Noir circuit language and Barretenberg proving backend. Privacy-first Ethereum L2, backed by Paradigm and Vitalik Buterin.
partners.incubated_by: Base (Coinbase L2) — Incubation program in progress.
